name: Passport reissue for change of name after marriage
name_hi: विवाह के बाद नाम परिवर्तन हेतु पासपोर्ट पुनः जारी करना
description: Apply for re-issue of an existing passport to change the name/surname due to marriage, submitting the old passport and either a marriage certificate or a joint photo declaration.
description_hi: विवाह के कारण नाम/उपनाम बदलने के लिए मौजूदा पासपोर्ट पुनः जारी करने का आवेदन करें, पुराने पासपोर्ट के साथ विवाह प्रमाणपत्र या संयुक्त फ़ोटो घोषणा जमा करें।
verification_notes: The booklet row is worded for 'A woman applying for change of name/ surname in existing Passport due to marriage' and lists documents '5, 14 or 56'; this is read as document 5 (old passport) plus either 14 (marriage certificate) or 56 (joint photo declaration). Address proof (document 1) applies only if the address also changed. Booklet V3.0 has no stated publication date.

requirements.name: Old passport in original (with self-attested copies)
Marriage certificate or joint photo declaration (any one)
requirements.name_hi: विवाह प्रमाणपत्र या संयुक्त फ़ोटो घोषणा (कोई एक)

options.notes: Attested copy issued by the Registrar of Marriage.
Signed by both husband and wife as per Annexure J.
